description.zh: 用18道原创文字视觉偏好题，比较田园、暗色学院、清爽极简、海岸休闲、林野奇趣与赛博朋克。全部最高并列完整报告免费，无需注册；附配色、材质和不购物小尝试，不判断人格或外貌。
description.en: Explore six aesthetics with 18 original word-based visual choices. Get every tied full guide, palettes, textures and no-purchase ideas free. No signup or personality verdict.

introduction.zh: What is my aesthetic——你更喜欢怎样的颜色、材质、图案与布局？本美学核心测试用18道文字描述的视觉偏好题，比较Cottagecore田园风、Dark Academia暗色学院风、Clean Girl清爽极简风、Coastal Grandmother海岸休闲风、Goblincore林野奇趣风与Cyberpunk赛博朋克风。它不是照片分析，也不把风格当作真实身份或人格。六份完整解释都可先读，作答后呈现原始计数与全部最高并列报告；配色与利用现有物品的小尝试免费，无需注册、购物或前置测评。
introduction.en: What is my aesthetic: which colours, textures, motifs and arrangements appeal to you? This test uses 18 original word-described visual choices to compare Cottagecore, Dark Academia, Clean Girl, Coastal Grandmother, Goblincore and Cyberpunk. It analyses no photo and treats style as neither a real identity nor personality. Read all six full guides first, then receive raw counts and every highest-count report. Original palettes and experiments with existing things are free without signup, purchases or a preceding assessment.

instructions.zh: 每题比较四段文字视觉描述，选择此刻更喜欢的一种，不按自己拥有多少物品、能否买到或某种人应该怎样回答。没有图片作答或照片上传；文字只帮助想象，不要求猜中标准风格。全部18题完成才显示结果，最高并列全部保留。你可以只喜欢某个颜色或材质，不必接受整个标签关联的生活方式。
instructions.en: Compare four word-described visual arrangements and choose the one you prefer now, without considering possessions, purchasing power or how a certain person should answer. There are no image choices or photo uploads. Descriptions support imagination rather than guessing a correct style. Complete all 18 for the result, keeping every highest-count tie. Liking one colour or texture does not require adopting a label’s associated lifestyle.

headline.zh: 温暖、花纹与手作感的组合
headline.en: Warmth, small patterns and handmade texture

summary.zh: 本题组中，你更常选择暖浅色、细小植物纹样、织纹与柔和轮廓。田园风在这里描述视觉偏好，不判断是否住在乡村、会种植烘焙、做事耐心或认同某种生活价值。
summary.en: Your choices more often favour warm pale colours, small plant motifs, woven textures and soft outlines. Cottagecore describes visual preferences here, without establishing rural residence, practical craft skills, patience or a particular set of values.

scoreReading.zh: 18道文字视觉偏好题，每题所选风格加1；六种风格各出现12次、每个选项位置3次。全部18题完成后显示六项原始次数和所有最高并列完整报告。没有随机定型、隐藏权重、强派副型或匹配百分比；接近次数没有经过验证的近分阈值。计数只描述本题组选择，不测美貌、品味高低、身份、心理特质或能力。
scoreReading.en: Each of 18 word-based visual choices adds one to its style. Every style appears 12 times and three times in each position. Complete all items for six raw tallies and every highest-count full report. There is no random assignment, hidden weighting, forced secondary type or match percentage; nearby counts have no validated close-score threshold. Counts describe these choices without measuring beauty, taste rankings, identity, psychological traits or ability.

paragraphs.zh: 本版田园风围绕柔和、温暖和带手作痕迹的画面组织选项。先看自己喜欢的是小花图案、暖木色，还是布面与纸张的触感想象；同样计数可以来自不同细节。它没有观察你怎样居住、吃饭或工作，也不要求把视觉兴趣变成一整套慢生活身份。
paragraphs.en: This edition groups softly warm scenes and handmade-looking details under Cottagecore. Revisit whether small floral patterns, warm wood tones or an imagined fabric-and-paper texture appealed to you. Similar tallies can come from different details. The items do not observe how you live, eat or work, and a visual interest need not become a complete slow-living identity.

title.zh: 一组可调整的配色例子

paragraphs.zh: 可以把暖米白 #F4E7D3、灰叶绿 #809671、柔土棕 #B38A67 和少量灰玫瑰 #C99693 当作本站的一组示例，而不是风格标准答案。先选一个作为大面积底色，其余只作小点缀；如果某个颜色不喜欢，直接替换。屏幕颜色与真实材料不同，不由这组代码决定购买或装修。
paragraphs.en: Try warm cream #F4E7D3, muted leaf green #809671, soft earth brown #B38A67 and a little dusty rose #C99693 as one original example, not a canonical answer. One can form the base and others small accents. Replace any colour you dislike. Screen colours differ from physical materials; these codes are not purchasing or renovation specifications.

paragraphs.zh: 可以留意细织纹、轻微不均匀边缘、小尺度花枝、格纹和圆润形状怎样放在一起。不是每个元素都需要出现，也不必真的使用古董、天然纤维或手工器物。现有物品的照片、自己的线条图与纸面纹理都能帮助比较；视觉上的手作感不能证明一个物品的生产方式、品质或环保属性。
paragraphs.en: Notice how fine weave, slightly uneven edges, small flowering motifs, checks and rounded shapes work together. None is compulsory, and the look needs neither antiques, natural fibres nor handmade objects. Photos of existing possessions, your own drawings and paper textures can support comparison. A handmade appearance establishes neither production method, quality nor environmental credentials.

title.zh: 一个利用现有物品的例子

paragraphs.zh: 把已经有的一块花纹纸、一张暖色便签和一个普通圆形物件放在一起，先看小花密度和背景空白是否合意，再拍一张只供自己比较的照片。你可以只保留一种纹样，不需要为了“够田园”增加装饰。例子不要求采花、种植、购置器皿或改变居住空间，体验可以停在纸面。
paragraphs.en: Place patterned paper you already own beside a warm-toned note and an ordinary rounded object. Compare pattern density and empty background, then take a photo for your own reference. Keeping one motif is enough; more decoration is not proof of Cottagecore. The example requires no picking flowers, gardening, buying tableware or changing your home, and can remain on paper.

paragraphs.zh: 温暖花纹和层叠纹理可能让你喜欢，也可能在小画面里显得拥挤；可以先减少图案数量，而不是把不适感理解成不适合这种风格。照片里的乡村感也不等于实际乡村生活。这里讨论构图，不推断你逃避现实、做事缓慢、收入受限或缺少现代能力，更不把审美解释成性格缺点。
paragraphs.en: Warm patterns and layered texture may appeal or feel crowded in a small composition. Reduce the number of motifs before concluding the style cannot fit you. A rural-looking photograph is not rural life itself. These are visual tradeoffs, not evidence of escapism, slowness, limited income or difficulty with modern work, and no aesthetic choice establishes a personality flaw.

paragraphs.zh: 田园风与林野奇趣都可能用自然元素，本版前者更偏暖浅、细花与柔和手作感，后者更多苔色、斑点与自然不规则。海岸休闲更疏朗蓝白，暗色学院更深色书纸，清爽极简减少元素，赛博朋克突出人工亮光与技术形状。这只是选项分法，可以组合，不穷尽所有审美。
paragraphs.en: Cottagecore and Goblincore can both use natural motifs. Here Cottagecore favours pale warmth, small flowers and softly handmade texture, while Goblincore adds moss tones, speckles and irregularity. Coastal styles use more open blue-white arrangements, Dark Academia deeper paper-and-book motifs, Clean Girl fewer elements, and Cyberpunk artificial light and technical forms. These distinctions organise options rather than exhaust aesthetics.

paragraphs.zh: 你可以喜欢花纹布料却不想做家务，也可以住在城市、使用新技术或喜欢节奏快的工作。它们都不需要被田园标签纠正。审美不是性别、道德、政治、婚育或职业身份，本题没有测耐心、自律、实际工艺技能或幸福感；喜欢一个画面也不等于认可它关联的全部文化想象。
paragraphs.en: You can like floral fabric without enjoying domestic work, live in a city, use new technology or enjoy fast-paced work. None needs correcting to fit a label. Aesthetic preference is not gender, morality, politics, family role or occupation. Items assess neither patience, discipline, craft skill nor well-being, and liking an image need not endorse every cultural association around it.

paragraphs.zh: 用已有纸张或自己画的几个形状，做两张小构图：一张保留暖色与小花，另一张只保留暖色而减少花纹。比较真正吸引你的是色温、纹样还是柔和边缘，允许只取一部分。目标是找到喜欢的视觉条件，不是证明生活得够自然，也不需要让田园风计数变高。
paragraphs.en: Make two small arrangements from existing paper or your own shapes: one with warmth and floral detail, another retaining warmth but reducing pattern. Compare whether colour temperature, motifs or soft edges matter most, and keep only what you want. Explore visual conditions rather than proving a natural lifestyle or trying to raise a Cottagecore tally.

These are comparison suggestions, not requirements for darkness or age. Preserve readable text and background contrast rather than sacrificing clarity for atmosphere. A single deep accent can work without making an actual room dim.

paragraphs.en: Fine checks, paper edges, repeated book-spine-like lines and symmetrical frames can supply visual material. Your own drawings can represent them without expensive leather goods, a book collection or a real academic setting. Paper motifs and deep colours require no open flame. Safety, comfort and function remain separate conditions that a style result does not alter.

title.zh: 一个利用现有物品的例子

paragraphs.zh: 用一张自己写的便签、一册已拥有的普通笔记本与深色背景纸做一个小构图，比较竖线、叠层和空白的关系。内容可以是日常待办，不必借名人句子证明品味，也不翻拍受保护书页来公开使用。这个例子只用于看线条与色彩，既不评价知识水平，也不要求把生活布置成舞台。
paragraphs.en: Arrange a note you wrote, an ordinary notebook you own and dark background paper. Compare vertical lines, layers and blank space. Everyday tasks can supply the writing without borrowed quotations proving taste or reproducing protected pages for publication. The exercise concerns line and colour, not knowledge or a requirement to stage your life as an academic scene.

paragraphs.zh: 深色叠层可能带来你喜欢的厚重感，也可能让细节难以辨认；正式对称可能清楚，也可能限制想要的松动。可以增加浅色纸面或减少边框，看看更喜欢哪种关系。审美取舍不需要升级为心理解释，喜欢暗色不意味着忧郁、难亲近、保守或缺少现实参与，本题没有测这些特质。
paragraphs.en: Deep layers may create a visual weight you enjoy or make detail hard to distinguish; formal symmetry may feel clear or too restrictive. Add a pale paper area or remove a frame to compare. These visual tradeoffs require no psychological explanation. Liking deep colours establishes neither sadness, distance, conservatism nor disengagement from everyday life.

paragraphs.zh: 暗色学院与田园都可能出现纸和手作感，前者在本版更突出深色、书本与正式线条；赛博朋克也用暗底，但强调人工亮线与技术形状。清爽极简减少图案，海岸休闲偏浅蓝白与开阔，林野奇趣偏自然斑点与不规则。你可以组合它们，不用接受“某两种罕见或紧张”的说法。
paragraphs.en: Dark Academia and Cottagecore can share paper and handmade textures, while this edition emphasises deeper colours, books and formal lines for the former. Cyberpunk can share dark backgrounds but adds luminous technical forms. Clean Girl reduces motifs, Coastal styles favour open pale blue-white arrangements, and Goblincore natural speckles and irregularity. Combining them requires no claim that a pairing is rare or tense.

paragraphs.zh: 你可以喜欢书本图形而平时很少读小说，也可以喜爱浅色穿着、从事销售或技术工作。视觉偏好不认证学术身份，也不限制职业选择。相关文学可能有阴暗题材，但本版不把痛苦、睡眠不足、抑郁或过度学习当作风格要求，更不能用一次审美选择诊断情绪或判断智力。
paragraphs.en: You can like book motifs while rarely reading novels, wear pale colours or work in sales or technology. Taste certifies no academic identity and limits no occupation. Some associated literature has dark themes, but distress, lost sleep, depression and excessive study are not style requirements here. An aesthetic choice diagnoses no mood and supplies no intelligence judgment.

paragraphs.zh: 用相同的现有纸张做两张构图，一张深色背景加正式边框，另一张增加浅色与不对称空白。比较你喜欢的是色彩深度、书纸质感还是几何秩序，保留其中一项也可以。目的在于看清偏好，而不是证明有文化、读得够多或必须把现实生活变得忧郁。
paragraphs.en: Using the same paper you already have, compare a dark background with a formal border against a version with more pale space and asymmetry. Identify colour depth, paper texture or geometric order as possible attractions, keeping just one if you wish. Clarify taste rather than proving cultural knowledge, extensive reading or a need to make everyday life melancholy.

Start with two and decide whether a dark outline helps, without making everything beige. Keep text distinguishable from its background. Visual reduction requires neither removing useful or meaningful possessions nor adopting a skincare or appearance standard.

paragraphs.zh: 平整纸面、连续轮廓、几何边界和低密度图案可以成为比较线索，但不等于物品必须昂贵、无瑕或没有使用痕迹。可以用普通便签、旧文件夹的背面或自己的线条图来探索这种关系。清楚的构图也能容纳一块粗糙纹理，材料外观不能证明品质、阶层、专业能力或自我约束。

Ordinary notes, the back of an existing folder or your own line drawings can explore the relationship. A clear composition can include rough texture too. Appearance establishes neither quality, social class, professional competence nor self-restraint.

title.zh: 一个利用现有物品的例子

paragraphs.zh: 在已有纸面上放三个自己常用的小物件，先拍一张，再只改变间隔或拿走一个并不影响用途的元素，比较哪种构图更合意。不是把日常桌面变成必须保持的展台，也不需要让别人按你的偏好整理共享空间。例子用于观察间隔与形状，不给生活整洁程度打分。
paragraphs.en: Arrange three small objects you use on paper you already have. Take a photo, then change only the spacing or remove a nonessential element and compare compositions. This does not turn an everyday desk into a display that must be maintained or require others to organise shared space to your taste. Observe spacing and form rather than rating tidiness.

paragraphs.zh: 减少元素可能让你喜欢整体关系，也可能删掉自己其实在意的细节；相近颜色可能柔和，也可能让边界不够清楚。可以逐项试，而不是追求空到没有个人痕迹。风格是否适合某个小画面，与人的自律、焦虑、承受混乱能力和道德无关，本问卷没有测这些，也不把其他审美叫作不干净。
paragraphs.en: Reducing elements may clarify a relationship you enjoy or remove a detail you value; close colours may feel gentle or make boundaries hard to read. Compare one change at a time without erasing personal traces. A composition establishes nothing about discipline, anxiety, tolerance of disorder or morality. Other aesthetic choices are not thereby unclean.

paragraphs.zh: 清爽极简与海岸休闲都可偏浅色，本版前者更强调少元素和几何，后者更多蓝白、条纹与宽松布面。田园加入暖花纹，暗色学院加入深色书纸，林野奇趣关注自然斑点，赛博朋克加入人工亮线。你可以保留极简布局并加入任一线索，均分或计数不规定纯粹程度，也不认证配对。
paragraphs.en: Clean Girl and Coastal styles can share pale colours. Here the former emphasises fewer elements and geometry, while the latter adds blue-white stripes and relaxed fabric. Cottagecore adds warm florals, Dark Academia deeper paper motifs, Goblincore natural speckles and Cyberpunk luminous technical lines. A simple layout can include any cue without a tally deciding purity or compatible pairings.

paragraphs.en: The internet label has cultural disputes involving appearance, gender and resources. Here it identifies visual cues without making clean a claim of purity or superiority. Anyone can like the style without smooth skin, makeup, a particular body or income. The result evaluates no person and establishes no suitability for nutrition, branding, beauty or another occupation.

paragraphs.zh: 用同一组已有形状做两个小画面，只改变间隔和颜色数量，再比较自己偏好的部分。可以保留一个有纪念意义的复杂物件，不必为了极简把它移除或丢弃。目标是看清留白和层次怎样配合，不是证明足够自律、改善健康或把真实生活变成没有杂物的图片。
paragraphs.en: Make two small compositions from the same existing shapes, changing only spacing and the number of colours. Keep a complex meaningful object if you want rather than discarding it for minimalism. Explore how open space and layers work together, without proving discipline, improving health or making real life resemble an object-free image.

paragraphs.en: Broad stripes, light weave, pale wood and open outlines are comparison cues without requiring linen, an ocean view or expensive furniture. Photos of existing fabric, drawn stripes and simple shapes can represent them. A visually airy composition guarantees neither temperature, air quality nor comfort in a real space, and appearance establishes neither natural materials nor quality.

title.zh: 一个利用现有物品的例子

paragraphs.zh: 拿已有的浅色纸张画几条疏朗蓝线，把它与一张普通物件照片放在一起，试着增加或减少周围空白。也可以完全不用蓝色，只比较舒展间隔与布纹。例子不要求布置餐桌、招待朋友或到海边拍照，任何生活条件下都可以停留在一个小小的纸面构图，不必扮演某种角色。

Vary the surrounding space, or omit blue and compare only intervals and fabric texture. No table setting, entertaining or beach photography is required. The exercise can remain a small paper composition without adopting a role.

paragraphs.zh: 浅色疏朗可能让你喜欢，也可能缺少想要的焦点；可以加入一条较深的线或一种已有纹理，而不是直接添很多物件。舒适的视觉感受是个人偏好，不表示生活更健康、关系更好或节奏更成熟。报告不把某个画面当财富标准，也不由喜欢它推断你逃避压力、不适合快节奏工作或特别会照顾人。
paragraphs.en: A pale open arrangement may appeal or lack a focal point you want. Add a darker line or an existing texture instead of many new objects. A visual preference establishes neither healthier living, better relationships nor mature pacing. It supplies no wealth standard or inference about avoiding pressure, disliking fast work or being especially capable of caring for others.

Cottagecore favours warm florals, Dark Academia deep paper motifs, Goblincore natural irregularity and Cyberpunk bright technical lines. Combining cues requires no claim that a pairing is rare, tense or a fixed lifestyle.

paragraphs.en: Grandmother in this label requires neither being a grandmother, a woman nor a particular age, and pale colours create no caring obligation. You can live in a city, have no garden, avoid entertaining or enjoy busy work. Items assess neither generosity, social skill, relationships, cooking nor interior-design ability, and include no occupational or class judgment.

paragraphs.zh: 用相同已有纸面做两种版本，一种保留浅蓝白条纹，另一种保留浅色而换成更整齐几何。比较自己真正想要的是颜色、织纹还是开阔间隔，不必为贴近名字增加物品。这个尝试帮助辨认视觉线索，不要求变得悠闲、热情好客或拥有某种住宅，也不把别人是否喜欢作为能力评分。

Identify colour, weave or open intervals as possible attractions without adding possessions to fit a name. title.zh: 一个利用现有物品的例子

paragraphs.zh: 选一张自己已有的物件照片，留意磨损边缘或细小斑点，再在纸上画几种不完全相同的轮廓。比较整齐重复与自然变化哪种更合意，不需要带走自然环境里的任何东西。这个例子只用于看表面关系，也不要求把所有有痕迹的旧物当作宝物或为风格不断增加收藏。
paragraphs.en: Choose a photo of an object you already own, notice a worn edge or small speckles and draw several uneven outlines on paper. Compare orderly repetition with natural variation without taking anything from a habitat. The exercise concerns surface relationships, not treating every worn object as treasure or continually acquiring more things for a style.

paragraphs.zh: 细节很多时，可能需要一个比较平静的底色；不规则太密时，也可以留出间隔，让自己真正喜欢的形状更清楚。这里是在调整构图，不把“乱”美化成人人都应接受的生活安排。喜欢这种图案既不证明观察力更强，也不能用来判断是否存在临床问题，更不让个人审美替共享空间的协商作主。

This adjusts composition rather than requiring everyone to accept a disorderly arrangement. Liking such motifs proves neither stronger observation nor any clinical condition, and personal taste cannot decide how a shared space should work.

paragraphs.en: You can enjoy worn textures without collecting objects, or use a formal smooth style at work. One choice establishes neither hygiene, life organisation, values nor social skill, and natural motifs define no group identity. Items assess neither hoarding, mood, personality nor natural-science knowledge, and a preferred image establishes no suitability for conservation, fieldwork or another occupation.

Keep one sketch if you want and leave the others. Clarify visual interest rather than proving a larger collection, finer observation than others or a need to reject order.

title.zh: 一个利用现有物品的例子

paragraphs.zh: 在一张已有深色纸上画几条交错线，用一小块亮色纸标出交点，再比较对称与错位的版本。画面可以是抽象的，不必让它看起来像任何现成游戏。这个例子帮助观察暗亮关系和叠层，不需要购置装备、使用真实电路或表现“会黑客技术”，也没有把视觉效果当专业能力。
paragraphs.en: Draw crossing lines on dark paper you already have and use a bright scrap at an intersection. Compare aligned and offset versions. The composition can remain abstract without resembling a particular game. Observe contrast and layering without buying equipment, using circuitry or performing an identity as a hacker. A visual effect supplies no professional-ability evidence.

paragraphs.en: A bright accent can form a focal point, while many luminous lines can compete. Layers may interest you or obscure text. Remove a layer or reduce colours without making complexity a test of authenticity. Preference establishes neither pessimism, coldness nor skill with systems. These items assess no mood, politics, empathy or technical ability; the tradeoff concerns this composition.

Clean Girl can supply a simpler layout, Goblincore irregular texture, and Cottagecore or Coastal cues different pale tones. Combining them requires no dystopian or anti-technology position and proves no rare, tense or more advanced pairing.

A literary genre, visual style and real person are different things; political or ethical views need direct discussion. paragraphs.en: Compare two abstract paper compositions: dark with many bright lines, and one intersection with more open space.
